sentence: This project gives a research center data management and bioinformatics support for studies of women's health and sex differences.
This project uses CRISPR genome editing to correct gene mutations that cause osteopetrosis, then tests cell infusions that need no conditioning treatment.
This project studies how a chemokine weakens tumor immunity and how it could be changed to help patients.
This project provides CRISPR gene editing and screening services that help find targets for cancer and test small-molecule drugs on cells.
This project builds a tissue resource and website for studying alcohol-induced pathologies in monkeys with known alcohol intake.
This project studies how a type of neuron in the hypothalamus controls arousal, stress and motivation through signals between cells.
This project runs a summer research experience in neurobiology.
This project builds a computer model using deep learning to study how inflammation leads to thrombosis in patients with COVID-19.
This project studies how Chlamydia makes its inclusions fuse together and which molecules control the fusion.
This project studies how cells choose which antigens to show on their surfaces and how this shapes the immune response to viruses and tumors.
This project tests in mouse models whether restoring a key gene can reverse a genetic disorder that affects brain development.
This project builds an automated video system that judges how well surgeons perform basic laparoscopic skills.
This project runs a pilot program that supports research on digestive diseases.
This project studies how the microbiome and resistance genes before surgery are linked to surgical site infection in veterinary orthopedic surgery.
This project studies how stress changes the mitochondrial redox environment and how that affects brain circuits for cognitive control in adolescents and young adults.
This project studies how pulsatile follicle-stimulating hormone signals in the ovary of mice affect oocyte quality and ovarian aging.
This project tests how lipid pathways, including statins, affect an oncogenic pathway in hepatocellular carcinoma cells.
This project studies how resident memory T cells form, are maintained and work against infections and cancer.
This project offers a doctoral program that combines molecular biology, genetics and computational methods for analyzing large datasets.
This project tests whether a cell penetrating peptide can carry cargo into cells and the mouse brain through a specific nicotinic receptor subtype.
